summary: P0 Umlaut-Fix in auth_routes.py build_verification_code_email and P2 Cookie-Consent-Banner (DSGVO/nDSG-konform mit 4 Kategorien) fully verified. 10/10 backend pytest tests pass (umlaut/accents in DE/FR/IT, send-code endpoint, datenschutz section). All 7 frontend cookie banner flows verified end-to-end: banner appears after localStorage.clear+reload, accept-all/necessary-only/save-preferences persist correctly to trucksonroad-consent-v1 with version+consent+decided_at, settings modal shows 4 categories with necessary disabled, footer-cookie-settings reopens modal, datenschutz page renders with all 4 cookie categories.
critical_code_review_comments: Hidden checkbox inputs in CookieBanner.js (.sf-cookie-toggle input) are visually toggled via .sf-cookie-toggle-track span. Playwright cannot click hidden checkboxes directly with .click() — used JS .click() in tests. Consider associating the visual track via <label> wrapper which is already done; no fix needed (works for real users), but worth noting for future automated tests.

CookieConsentContext.js: useEffect on mount only checks localStorage once — if user changes consent in another tab, current tab is not synced. Minor edge case for SSR/multi-tab scenarios; not blocking for MVP.

build_verification_code_email() inlines all 4 language labels directly. With future i18n expansion, consider extracting to a translations module to keep auth_routes.py lean (current file is ~383 lines, still acceptable).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (cookie banner: visibility, accept-all, necessary-only, settings modal with 4 categories, save-preferences with selective toggles, footer-cookie-settings reopens modal, datenschutz page renders 4 categories + Cookie-Einstellungen text, AGB+Impressum render)
